name: claude-phase3-blast-radius
description: Phase 3: enumerate what the agent identity reaches. Read-only recon of cloud creds, git remotes, registries, metadata endpoints, and recoverable secrets. Do NOT exercise write/publish paths without a named exception. Tool names assume Claude Code.

steps.note: identity: who is the agent running as

input.command: aws iam list-attached-user-policies --user-name $(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ '{print $NF}') 2>&1 | head -40
gcloud auth list 2>&1; gcloud config list 2>&1

steps.text: Phase 3 blast-radius enumeration complete. Do not exercise write paths without authorization.
